analysis.primary: Intention-to-treat: every valid rater row is included in the primary analysis regardless of any judgment it contains. Report raw counts per condition per measure with Wilson 95% intervals. No LLM judge; no self-rating by the agent.
analysis.retention: Included and excluded rater ids, exclusion reasons, and both denominators are retained in the analysis receipt.
analysis.sensitivity_only: A separately labeled sensitivity analysis may exclude raters who fail the independent attention check. It is never the primary result.

attention_check.independence: The check reads only this field. It never reads target_emotion_choice, embry_identity, identity_confidence, naturalness, or preference_rank, so it cannot select raters on the primary outcome.
attention_check.question: Type the final word of the spoken sentence (same sentence in every clip).

blinding: Condition labels are absent from stimulus filenames presented to raters; use stimulus_id. This file contains the key and must not be shown to raters.

does_not_prove: anything at all until human raters respond
that any embedding score corresponds to perception
any tone profile or renderer policy beyond these four exact WAV files

hypothesis: Listeners recognize the dream-derived session mood above chance, and rate the dream condition as recognizably Embry at parity with control.
measures_in_order: target-emotion recognition (forced choice among the four tone labels)
content equivalence (does the sentence mean the same thing? yes/no)
preference (secondary, reported but not used for the primary claim)

presentation.note: The rater page derives the same order client-side from the typed rater id; no fixed global order exists in v2.
presentation.order_hash: FNV-1a 32-bit over 'salt:rater_id', modulo 4, selecting one Williams sequence

primary_measure: target-emotion recognition accuracy for the dream condition (intention-to-treat)
scope_statement: Four stimuli x 20 raters is a four-WAV feasibility pilot over these exact preregistered files. It does not validate any tone profile, rendering policy, or renderer across texts, seeds, or repeated synthesis.

stimulus_source.answer_text: I need you to wait before you commit to that plan, because the constraint changed this morning.
stimulus_source.note: Identical answer text and identical speaker reference across all four conditions; only voice_delivery differs. That is what makes the comparison matched.

stopping_rule: Fixed n=20 raters. No interim analysis, no extension after seeing results. A null or negative result is a valid outcome.

supersedes.note: v1 is preserved unmodified as a historical artifact; its fixed global order and outcome-dependent exclusion are superseded by this file.

v1_response_isolation: v1 responses.jsonl rows (if any ever existed) are never mixed into v2 analysis; v2 reads responses_v2.jsonl only.
